$comment: HERD1's budget, as android-compat.yml's storm scenario checks it (check-budget.mjs) over every request home hears in the whole run (every route: home's limiter answers 429 only under /api/v1/, as the stub does, but HERD1's pace takes a turn for /compat and the session check too): in any window of T ms, at most burst + ceil(T / sustainedMs) requests; after a 429, none until its Retry-After has passed (pairing and sign-out excepted; graceMs for the 429 to reach the phone over the slowed link), then at most one per sustainedMs for pacedForMs. Per pull, HERD1 promises structure, not a count (one pull may reach the burst): a pull while another is still under way joins it (HERD1, HERD2's refreshers), which storm.sh checks as its 'joined' phase with home answering slowly; a pull after one has ended is asked afresh (HERD2). From HERD1, PR #3110 (apps/www/src/lib/home-link/__tests__/herd.test.ts) and HERD2, PR #3112 (apps/www/src/lib/pull-refresh/__tests__/refreshers.test.ts).
